agenda_text:
SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  Terry Kistler, Chair
Scott Snider, Vice Chair  Jenny Jolly, Committee Member
George Borst, Committee Member  Mary Smith, Committee Member
Edward Padgett, Committee Member  Bette Donovan Committee Member

  Wednesday, April 15, 2026
  Regular Meeting at 10:00 AM
  La Verne Community Center
  3680 D Street, La Verne, CA 91750
Attendance and participation at the City of La Verne Senior Advisory Committee meetings are
welcomed and appreciated. Community engagement provides the Committee with valuable
information. In compliance with the American Disabilities Act, any person with a disability who
requires a modification or accommodation in order to participate in a meeting should contact the City
Clerk’s Office at (909) 596-8726 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

Persons addressing the Senior Advisory Committee shall be limited to 3 minutes unless an extension
of time is granted by the Chair, subject to approval of the Committee Members. When any group of
persons wishes to address the Committee, it shall be proper for the Chair to request that a
spokesperson be chosen to represent the group.

Public comments will be allowed on items on this Agenda at the time each item is considered.

Mission of the Senior Advisory Committee
To plan for coordinated delivery of services to senior citizens to eliminate duplication and conflict of
effort, as well as to inform its seniors of the availability of programs.

CALL TO ORDER AND PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

SWEARING IN OF NEW MEMBER

ROLL CALL

PRESENTATIONS

1.  Jen Sancen, Senior Companion Director, AgingNext

APPROVAL OF MINUTES

2.  Wednesday, March 18, 2026

DISCUSSION ITEMS

3.
  a. Senior Nutrition Program
 AGENDA  Senior Citizen Advisory Committee 4/15/2026  Page 2

  b. Bingo Report
  c. Account Balance Update
  d. Monthly Senior Program Fees
  e. AgingNext
  f. Facilites Report
  g. Upcoming Events

PUBLIC COMMENT
Public comments will be allowed on items not on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction
of the Committee; however, no action may be taken on off-agenda items except as provided by law.

STAFF/COMMITTEE COMMUNICATION & INFORMATION
Committee members may ask a question for clarification, make a brief announcement, make a brief
report on his/her own activities, request staff to report back at a subsequent meeting concerning any
matter, or take action to direct staff to place a matter of business on a future agenda.

ADJOURNMENT

The next regularly scheduled meeting of the Senior Advisory Committee will be held at
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, May 20, 2026 at the La Verne Community Center.

Posting Statement: A true copy of this Agenda was posted on Wednesday, April 8, 2026 on
the bulletin board at La Verne City Hall, 3660 D Street, La Verne, and on the City’s website at
www.laverneca.gov
minutes_text:
MINUTES OF THE SENIOR ADVISORY COMMITTEE
  REGULAR MEETING
  Wednesday, April 15, 2026

  ACTION MINUTES
  “See items in italics”
  _________________________________________________________________

1. A regular meeting of the La Verne Senior Advisory Committee was called to order at:
  10:00 AM on Wednesday, April 15, 2026.

  Members present: Bette Donovan, Terry Kistler, Scott Snider, Jenny Jolly, Edward
  Padgett, Mary Smith, George Borst

  Members Absent: None.

  Staff Present: Yvonne Duran, Parks & Recreation Director, Armando Cisneros,
  Parks & Recreation Specialist, Robyn Olsen, Parks & Recreation Specialist.

  It was moved by George Borst and seconded by Ed Padgett to approve the
  minutes of Wednesday, March 18, 2026 meeting. Motion carried.

2. Guest Speaker: Jen Sancen, Senior Companion Director and Lora Galindo,
  Resource Specialist. Presented information about the programs offered with
  AgingNext. The Senior Companion program connects a home-bound senior with
  a senior visitor. The visits may include the following: transportation assistance
  for medical appointments, grocery stores, shopping, movies, companionship,
  social support, and respite for caregivers.

  Unfinished Business

3. Senior Nutrition Program:

  Congregate Meals: 548 meals were served to an average of 21 participants in
  March. Meals have been lowered to 27 meals per day due to budget constraints
  with the YWCA.

  Meals on Wheels: 503 meals were served to La Verne recipients in February.
  493 meals were served to La Verne recipients in March.

4. Bingo Report: Receipts for March totaled $8,804.00 (rent to City of La Verne
  $270.00; supplies expense to Bingo West $1,054.00; Payouts $6,760.00).
  Attendance was 272 participants from Mid-April to Mid-May.

5. Account Balance: $5,559.11

6. Senior Program Fees: All program fees are paid.
 7. MT. SAC Classes: The spring session is going well. Somes classes have been
  moved around due to the Senior Craft Room closure.

8. Voting on the Vice Chair: Terry Kistler nominated Scott Snider for Vice Chair and
  voted on by the group. It was approved by all members present.

9. Aging Next: Total number of La Verne residents served for the month of
  March was 7.

  New Business

10. Facilities Report: Yvonne reported the leak in the Senior Craft Room will be
  repaired. The room needs complete renovations. More gutters will be
  installed to help with the roof issues. Veterans Hall is in good condition.
  Aquatic Center is in good condition.

11. Upcoming Events

  •  Saturday, April 18th – Excursion: Ramona Bowl, 12:00PM-8:30PM.
  •  Wednesday, April 22nd – Senior Seminar: Maintain your Brain, Presented by Independence at Home,
  10:30AM.
  •  Sunday May 3rd – Senior Dinner Dance, Under the Blossoms, 4:00PM – 7:00PM.
  •  Saturday, May 9th – Excursion: Catalina Island, 8:00AM-8:30PM.
  •  Monday, May 11th – Movie Matinee: The Breakfast Club, 12:30PM.
  •  Tuesday, May 12th – Volunteer Recognition Luncheon: Aloha & Recognition, 10:00AM-12:45PM.
  •  Wednesday, May 13th – Senior Seminar: Hoarding, Presented by the YWCA, 10:45AM.

  Public Comments: Terry Kistler mentioned that the children on electric bikes are
  posing a safety issue for drivers. Yvonne Duran stated that she is currently
  working on the budget.

  Adjourn: The meeting was adjourned at 10:50AM. The next meeting will be held on
  Wednesday, May 20, 2026 at 10:00AM.

  Submitted by:
  Armando Cisneros
  Parks & Recreation Specialist
